key_insight: Machine learning can accurately predict band gaps in diverse halide perovskites, and the most influential drivers are B-site and X-site chemistry plus site-count structural descriptors.
engineering_relevance: These models can speed up screening of lead-free perovskites by linking composition and structure to band gap targets for optoelectronic design.
method: Trained ensemble tree-based regressors on atomic and structural descriptors.
Compared random forest regression, gradient-boosted regression trees, and XGBoost for band gap prediction.
Used feature-importance analysis to identify the most critical chemical and structural inputs.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong predictive accuracy across multiple machine-learning algorithms on a broad set of halide perovskite band gaps.
watch_item: Feature-importance results are model-dependent, so predictions should be validated experimentally before materials selection or device integration.
paper_title: Machine learning insights into band gap properties in halide-based perovskites
